name: io.github.xcalibur73/webaudits-mcp
description: Real-time Core Web Vitals (LCP) telemetry, DOM bloat analysis, and AI search crawler (GEO) readiness audits for AI coding assistants.

tools.name: audit_dom_bloat
tools.description: Analyzes HTML tree structure to report total DOM elements, maximum depth, and container ratio.

tools.name: audit_geo_readiness
tools.description: Audits robots.txt for AI search crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) and checks /llms.txt.

tools.name: audit_lcp_trace
tools.description: Measures server TTFB and flags Largest Contentful Paint delays such as lazy-loaded hero images.
